title: finance-legal personal todo - alex kim
content:
Personal finance/legal scratchpad - Alex Kim
Last updated: 2026-02-28

Top priorities (today)
- [ ] Process / verify invoices due this week (see list below). Need final ok from Maya on any > $10k.
- [ ] Finish redline for ModelOps Inc. SOW and send to Jordan for legal review (deadline 2026-03-03).
- [ ] Renew DataLabel Co subscription: confirm renewal amount and whether to renegotiate seat pricing.
- [ ] Follow up with procurement on CloudInfra LLC outstanding PO (PO-2026-017).

Invoice checklist
- INV-2026-0112 | CloudInfra LLC | $12,450 | due 2026-03-05 | platform infra costs (Jan-Feb)
  - Notes: partial usage mismatch on line 3 vs billing portal. Maya to confirm usage report. Hold payment until reconcile?
  - Action: attach usage CSV + email vendor for clarification (Jordan to cc for contract terms)

- INV-2026-0105 | DataLabel Co | $4,200 | due 2026-03-01 (overdue)
  - Notes: renewal invoice auto-generated. We intended annual discount - check PO and previous invoice for discount code.
  - Action: call Eleanor at DataLabel today; ask for corrected invoice and delay payment 7 days.

- INV-2026-0098 | ResearchConsult LLC | $2,100 | due 2026-03-10
  - OK to pay after PO matched.

Contract redlines / SOWs
- ModelOps Inc. SOW (v3_redline.docx)
  - Key points to change: 1) IP clause - ensure customer-created prompts remain customer-owned; 2) Liability cap to $1M (was open); 3) Termination for convenience 60 -> 90 days? confirm with product.
  - Outstanding: confidentiality appendix missing signature block for Redwood. Add block.
  - Target: send to vendor 2026-03-01 for countersign by 2026-03-10.

- DataLabel Co subscription T&C renewal (auto-renew)
  - Question: can we convert to annual prepaid to get discount? Who owns vendor relationship: Procurement (Rita) but need legal sign-off for modified SLA.
  - Action: draft renegotiation email; include seat counts and desired price.

Renewals & reminders
- DataLabel Co: 2026-03-01 renewal (see invoice INV-2026-0105) - HIGH priority
- CloudInfra reserved capacity commit review: renewals Q2 - schedule meeting with infra ops to review usage curve (Jordan to set up)
- Domain registrar (redwood-inference.com) expires 2026-04-12 - check payment card on file.

Payments / approvals
- Approval thresholds: > $10k requires Maya sign-off. INV-2026-0112 flagged.
- Payment method: use corporate CC for <$5k invoices, ACH for >$5k after approval.

Open questions / follow-ups
- Does SOW with ModelOps require vendor to carry cyber insurance? check Legacy contract clause. (JIRA LEGAL-211)
- Who owns negotiation of CloudInfra PO change? Procurement but they asked finance to validate cost center mapping. Note to self: update cost center mapping doc.
- Are there any outstanding NDAs from new vendor pilot (Pilot-2026-A)? Search Slack #vendor-onboarding.

Meeting notes snippets
- 2026-02-26 sync with Maya: she wants monthly vendor spend dashboard by 1st of month. Action: get exported card charges by vendor + tagging from accounting.
- 2026-02-20 quick with Jordan: preferred redline approach -> track all changes in doc and include short summary email per legal change. Good to keep tight timeline.

Templates / snippets to reuse
- Payment email template: "Hi <vendor>, we've received INV-XXXX, validating usage. We'll aim to process by <date> after reconciliation. If you can confirm <line-item> we can clear sooner."
- Contract cover note (for vendor): one-paragraph summary of key redlines and who to contact at Redwood (Legal: Jordan Lee; Finance: Alex Kim).

Short-term timeline
- 2026-03-01: DataLabel corrected invoice or grace period agreement
- 2026-03-03: Send ModelOps redline to Jordan for legal review
- 2026-03-05: Final decision on CloudInfra invoice payment or partial hold
- 2026-03-10: Target countersign for ModelOps SOW

Notes to self / quick reminders
- Keep notes lightweight here; move final copies to Confluence under Finance > VendorDocs.
- Tag Jira tickets when I send redlines (FIN-482 / LEGAL-211).
- If I don't hear back from DataLabel by EOD, escalate to procurement (Rita).

Random log (for tracking)
- 2026-02-25 10:14 AM - emailed CloudInfra billing contact (billing@cloudinfra.com) re: line item mismatch
- 2026-02-26 2:00 PM - called DataLabel account rep, asked for corrected invoice; rep said will escalate and send by 02/28

End of scratchpad.

Unresolved / todo backlog (not urgent)
- Consolidate vendor contract renewal dates into spreadsheet (quarterly project)
- Confirm archive retention policy for old contracts (>7 years?) with legal ops
- Review prepaid card limits for ad-hoc purchases
personal_todos: Finalize ModelOps SOW redlines and send to Jordan
Confirm DataLabel renewal terms and negotiate seat pricing
Follow up on PO-2026-017 with procurement
